entries.477b8bef6bb92af7: Since its founding in 1973, rather than pursuing uniform chain expansion, it has developed formats with a different concept for each store; by owning formats across a wide range of cuisines, including Italian, Japanese and Asian, it can choose the format that suits each location, which is its strength. It also has a subsidiary in California, United States, giving it a channel to draw on its track record in operating overseas stores and local dining trends, which differentiates it from domestically focused restaurant operators.
entries.478bd14e46a00a9f: A food and beverage business that is the company group's single segment and mainly operates restaurants. In Japan, GLOBAL-DINING, INC. operates 43 restaurants, mainly in Tokyo, and its U.S. subsidiary, Global Dining, Inc. of California, operates three restaurants in Los Angeles (store counts as of the filing date). Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥13,660 million, of which Japan accounted for ¥11,149 million and the United States for ¥2,510 million by location.

entries.a613f99dfd53a3f9: It sets out as its purpose “Bringing joy and health to the world” and as its mission “to provide the finest stage where all customers are moved and employees can also be moved.” Its medium- to long-term management strategy is centered on “dining out as entertainment”, which it has pursued since its founding, and comprises: establishing a “new commercial facility package” that integrates lodging, dining, merchandise sales and events at “Nasu Paradise Village” in Nasushiobara City, Tochigi Prefecture; continuing to open existing formats while developing roadside stores that do not rely on alcohol and small-to-medium formats with high investment efficiency; and pursuing growth of the US business as its top priority, with a view to entering Asian regions such as Thailand and Indonesia beyond that.
